# Claude Code Skills and Commands

A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` file that teaches Claude a task.
A slash command is a short action that you type, such as `/compact` or `/model`.
For example, `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` gives you a `/deploy` command.

## Marks

| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ | A page of the [Claude Code docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) names it. |
| 🔍 | Only the Claude Code bundle names it. No docs page does. |
| ⚠️ | The docs and the bundle differ. The row says how. |
| 🧪 | It works only behind a flag, a plan, or a server-side switch. The row says which. |
| ❌ | It is removed or does nothing in `2.1.303`. |

## Built-In Command Facts

- The inventory `data/inv-2.1.303.json` holds 101 names (`slash_commands`).
  It includes the dynamic `mcp__` prefix and the internal `__remote-workflow`.
- It misses commands whose object puts `name` before `type`: `keybindings`, `release-notes`, `rewind`, `chrome`, `statusline`, `sandbox`.
  The Setup and Session pages list them.
- A command has up to two objects: a `local-jsx` panel and a `local` variant for non-interactive sessions.
  The gate for the second is "not interactive" (`launchOptions.isInteractive()` is false).
- Command kinds: `local-jsx`, `local`, `prompt`.
  Aliases come from the `aliases` array.
